Alternative.description:
One supportable position on a question, where no policy chose between them
(FR-CFL-03).
Alternative.title: Alternative

Anchor.description:
Where a passage sits in its document. Every anchor resolves to one location
(FR-SEG-01).
Anchor.title: Anchor

AnyOf.description: At least one operand must hold.
AnyOf.title: AnyOf

AuthorityLevel.description: One level in the profile. Two levels may share a rank, which makes them equal-ranked.
AuthorityLevel.title: AuthorityLevel

AuthorityOrderDefinition.description: Rank decides, highest first. Only meaningful where the profile resolves conflicts.
AuthorityOrderDefinition.title: AuthorityOrderDefinition

AuthorityProfile.description:
The ordered levels a domain's documents sit in (FR-AUT-01).

`resolves_conflicts` is what turns rank from description into policy. The pilot leaves it
false, so WCAG and the Style Manual stay equal and a conflict between them falls through to
the risk matrix.

AuthorityProfile.title: AuthorityProfile

BackboneMapping.description: A proposition mapped to a step, in backbone-led mode (Appendix C.1).

BackboneMapping.title: BackboneMapping

BackboneRelation.description: Appendix C.1. Proposition to step, in backbone-led mode.
BackboneRelation.title: BackboneRelation

Conclusion.description:
What a rule concludes. A DEFINITIONAL proposition compiles to a fact derivation, which
is a rule whose conclusion sets a fact (FR-CMP-01).
Conclusion.title: Conclusion

Condition.description:
A condition a proposition attaches to its obligation (FR-EXT-04).

`fact_type_id` is None until a fact type exists for it; a rule compiled from such a
condition is provisional until one is confirmed (FR-CMP-02), and INV-05 refuses a rule
whose condition has no fact type with a provider.
Condition.title: Condition

ConditionOperator.description: The comparisons a rule condition may make against a fact value.
ConditionOperator.title: ConditionOperator

ConfidenceBand.description:
A banded confidence. Bands, not raw probabilities, because a model's self-reported
probability is never the sole input to a status (FR-EPI-01).
ConfidenceBand.title: ConfidenceBand

Conflict.description: Two or more propositions that cannot both be followed (FR-CFL-01).

extensions.description: Domain-specific fields, keyed '<namespace>.<field>'. The only place a domain may add to a record without a core change (NFR-PRT-01).
extensions.title: Extensions

Conflict.title: Conflict

ConflictKind.description: FR-CFL-01 detects the first four deterministically; FR-VOC-02 raises terminology.
ConflictKind.title: ConflictKind

ConflictStatus.description: Where a conflict has got to (spec section 4).
ConflictStatus.title: ConflictStatus

ConservativeDefinition.description: An ordering, most conservative first, used when inference is off or budget is spent.
ConservativeDefinition.title: ConservativeDefinition

Consideration.description:
One thing the procedure weighs, and the proposition it comes from.

Spec section 4 says considerations are "each sourced", so the source is required: a
judgement that weighs something no passage supports is the tool adding content (FR-TOO-03).
Consideration.title: Consideration

ConsistencyState.description: Spec section 4, one dimension of epistemic status.
ConsistencyState.title: ConsistencyState

CorpusKind.description: What kind of corpus a domain is built from.
CorpusKind.title: CorpusKind

DataType.description: The type of a fact type's value (spec section 4).
DataType.title: DataType

Deadline.description: A structured duration with the event it runs from (FR-TMP-01).
Deadline.title: Deadline

DecidedBy.description: Spec section 4. How a conflict was resolved, or that it was not.
DecidedBy.title: DecidedBy

DecisionKind.description: What a decision log entry records (INV-12).
DecisionKind.title: DecisionKind

DecisionLogEntry.description: One decision, with everything needed to reproduce and to audit it.
DecisionLogEntry.title: DecisionLogEntry

DecisionPolicy.description: A domain's declared way to resolve conflicts and alternatives (glossary 1.5).

extensions.title: Extensions

DecisionPolicy.title: DecisionPolicy

Defeat.description:
One rule defeating another, with why (spec section 4).

The defeating rule is the rule that carries this, so only the defeated one is named.
Defeat.title: Defeat

Document.description:
One source document in a snapshot.

`authority_level` is a key into the domain's authority profile and `licence_class` decides
whether text may be stored at all; INV-06 checks both, and INV-11 enforces the second.

ElementKind.title: ElementKind

ElementStatus.description: Whether an element has been confirmed. The pilot skeleton marks every element confirmed.
ElementStatus.title: ElementStatus

EpistemicOverall.description: DP-05: the status that travels with every claim. Computed, never set (see `epistemic`).
EpistemicOverall.title: EpistemicOverall

EpistemicStatus.description: The status carried by every record (spec section 4, DP-05).

FactCondition.title: FactCondition

FactType.description:
A typed input rules depend on, with an ordered list of providers (glossary 1.5).

`closed_world` defaults to false, so a missing fact is UNKNOWN rather than false: there is
no negation as failure on an open-world fact (FR-QRY-01).

NotCondition.description: The operand must not hold. Three-valued, so UNKNOWN negates to UNKNOWN (FR-QRY-01).

Origin.description: Spec section 4. A file marked `edited` is only re-proposed as a diff (FR-CFG-02).

Outcome.description:
One way out of a decision point, and where it leads.

INV-03 requires every decision to carry an `unable_to_determine` outcome *with an edge*,
so the target is what makes the outcome more than a label.
Outcome.title: Outcome

Override.description:
A caller's or reviewer's replacement for an automated decision (FR-JDG-04).

Overrides always win, and show in the response as `overridden` (FR-TOO-02).

ParseStatus.description: The S1 exit gate: every file is parsed, referenced or rejected with a reason.
ParseStatus.title: ParseStatus

A unit of segmented source text (FR-SEG-01).

`text` is None for a `reference` or `excluded` source, which is what INV-11 checks. Source
text is recoverable from the anchor and offsets either way (FR-ING-02).
